about: Pilot test questions (approved by the user on 2026-11-05, Arabizi corrected by the user). Each question lists the answers accepted as correct: a SQL query (scored by comparing its result with the model's) or a reply type (CLARIFY, UNSUPPORTED, REPLY). Questions in the same group are spellings of the same question. Date placeholders: {THIS_MONTH}, {LAST_MONTH}, {LAST_WEEK}, {AUGUST}, {SEPTEMBER}, {OCTOBER}.
